caption: The drawing contains six square swatches arranged in two horizontal rows of three on a beige background. The top left square has a white background with a sparse pattern of small green and black floral motifs and tiny black dots. The top middle square has a bold red background with a repeating geometric motif formed by vertical cream rectangles. The top right square features a white background with larger symmetrical floral patterns in shades of pink and smaller scattered red leaves. The bottom left square has a brown background covered with a diamond grid of lighter brown and white dots, creating a checkered appearance. The bottom middle square displays a white background with a repeating black motif resembling stylized flowers, punctuated by horizontal pink and white stripes. The bottom right square features a brown background with scattered delicate pink flowers, green leaves, and white branching stems. Each square is bordered by thin, faint lines separating them from the background and from each other.
